keys.name: Terminale
keys.cmd: $TERMINAL || foot || x-terminal-emulator || gnome-terminal || alacritty || kitty || xterm

keys.name: Mute Audio
keys.cmd: wpctl set-mute @DEFAULT_AUDIO_SINK@ toggle || pactl set-sink-mute @DEFAULT_SINK@ toggle

keys.name: Mute Mic
keys.cmd: wpctl set-mute @DEFAULT_AUDIO_SOURCE@ toggle || pactl set-source-mute @DEFAULT_SOURCE@ toggle

keys.name: Screenshot
keys.cmd: grim -g "$(slurp)" - | wl-copy || flameshot gui || spectacle -r || gnome-screenshot -i
